name: accessibility-audit
description: Run evidence-backed WCAG 2.2 A/AA audits at desktop, mobile, and reflow viewports and export a validated Excel report.

interface.shortDescription: Audit pages and generate an evidence-backed Excel report.
interface.longDescription: Runs headless Playwright and axe checks at desktop, mobile, and reflow viewports, validates links and tab components conservatively, links focused element-level evidence without bloating the workbook, reports progress, writes validated partial output after graceful cancellation, and generates the CarlasHub WCAG 2.2 audit workbook.
defaultPrompt: Audit a URL and generate the validated Excel report.
Audit every page in a supplied page-list workbook.
Validate an existing accessibility audit workbook.
